properties.evidence: The reported mechanism is the one fixed: the surface is chosen once at startup and nothing re-probes, so a design built by `--import` after the handshake stays invisible. Validated by a test that builds a real store under a latent service and asserts `reflow2_start_design` refuses rather than starting a second design, plus two mutations that each kill exactly one case. Their ask (a), promoting the surface in place, is recorded as NOT buildable rather than silently substituted.
